purpose: Retest revised trajectory objective and executed optimizer configuration before any new long training
initialization: original verified generic source, random driving tokens/action/state/auxiliary heads, no learned pilot weights
paired_factors: Same initialization, train permutation, task/noise/time RNG, teacher identities, labels, optimizer recipe, schedule, batch and source within each S0/S3 pair. Only trajectory objective differs.

evaluation.population: all 1696 held-out dev scenes / 16 logs; never tune on Navtest
evaluation.cluster_bootstrap: paired differences, resample logs, 10000 replicates, seed 20261008
evaluation.repeat: 128 hash-selected dev scenes x four inference seeds, diagnosis only

early_decision.reject: Significant PDMS degradation (paired log 95% CI upper <0), more zero/DAC-zero failures without compensating score improvement, nonfinite/no actual FP32 optimizer updates, or excessive runtime/memory overhead.
early_decision.continue_to_5000: No safety/score regression and positive paired point estimate or convincing improvement of DAC/zero failures; otherwise keep long training held.
early_decision.long_train_gate: Both S0/S3 5k finite checkpoints must have positive mean PDMS over matched controls; combined paired 95% CI lower >0; no increase of zero/DAC-zero counts and yaw tail; speed overhead <=20%. Independent V12 confirmation remains required before long-training the full label matrix.
early_decision.limitations: 2k is an early rejection gate, not proof of eventual100k quality. Changes in optimizer warmup/shared LR versus archived 100k runs are not an objective-only comparison; only within-pair contrast is causal.

calibration.mature_and_generic_sources: S3 r1 architecture; 4 uniform train +4 optimized accepted braking scenes; detached current condition and real decoder gradient; not full-model optimizer norms
calibration.actual_training_braking_normalization: global optimizer-batch exact count, includes original-target fallback scenes
